_comment: CANONICAL CYCLE-COUNT CEILING (see scripts/cycle-ratchet.mjs). The number of DISTINCT dependency cycles `.dependency-cruiser.cjs`'s `no-circular` rule reports over `src`. Never raise this to make a PR pass -- ratchet it DOWN when cycles are genuinely cut, exactly as #2798 and W1-T2895 did. A PR that adds a cycle fails the depcruise job -- and since W1-T2895, `no-circular` is `severity: "error"`, so it fails the whole cruise, not just this ratchet.
_methodology: Re-derived at the sha above from THE REPO'S OWN CONFIG, not an ad-hoc one: `depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type json`, filtered to violations whose `rule.name` is `no-circular`, each ring canonicalised by rotating to its lexicographically smallest member so the same ring reported from two entry points cannot count twice.
_history: #2798 cut the `open-prs-rest` <-> `sweep` type-only edge and took the count from 24 to 13. W1-T2895 cut the remaining 13: `isInPlanScope` (plan-architect.ts -> plan-scope.ts), `ghJson` (review.ts's import redirected to github-transport.ts, where W1-T2896 already defined it), `readLedgerLines` (review.ts routed through ledger-union.ts's readLedgerUnionRecordsSync instead of importing status.ts), `playwrightCacheRoot` (review.ts -> worker-home.ts, its only other consumer), `utcWeekWindowMs` (sweep.ts -> time-window.ts), `DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` (daemon.ts -> poll-interval.ts), and one `import type { BoardDeps }` edge (task-card.ts -> board.ts) that dependency-cruiser's `swc` parser -- required for this repo's TypeScript version -- does not recognise as type-only, so it counted as circular exactly like a value import; moving `BoardDeps` beside the `DeriveDeps` it extends in status.ts removed the edge instead of asking depcruise to ignore it.
